title: DiagEx — reproducibility package for zero-shot P&ID-to-DEXPI digitization with a vision-language agent
description:
Reproducibility package for the manuscript DiagEx: Zero-Shot P&ID-to-DEXPI Digitization with a Vision-Language Agent (Koziolek, Braun, Bordis — under review). Contains the diagex Python package, the evaluation harness, ground-truth corpora for 10 public P&IDs, final results CSVs and figures for Phase 1 / Phase 2 / a no-tile ablation / a GPT-4.1 baseline, replay cassettes for offline re-derivation, and the manuscript PDF.

Per-run agent transcripts and intermediate DEXPI 2.0 JSON / SVG / tile crops are in a separate supplementary deposition on Zenodo, cross-linked via related_identifiers below — replace the placeholder DOI before publishing.
